svg.text: PyTorch storage vs. the maths: who holds which slice
nn.Linear(in, out) stores weight W as [out, in] and computes y = x · Wᵀ + b. Write A = Wᵀ ([in, out]) to get the textbook y = x · A + b.
maths: rank r keeps COLUMNS 2r, 2r+1 of A1 → A1_r [4,2]
PyTorch: the same numbers are ROWS of W1 → W1_r [2,4]
not split: added once, after the all-reduce
maths: rank r keeps ROWS 2r, 2r+1 of A2 → A2_r [2,4]
PyTorch: the same numbers are COLUMNS of W2 → W2_r [4,2]
